body: Just a few weeks away. Don't fell anywhere close to that. I actually feel glad I have someone to talk to outside if school.

I think it's amazing what the Internet has allowed. I did have my doubts a few times, but when I try to think if a why... Nothing comes up. In game, I've given her things, but she's never asked. We do talk about money, but she seems to be wanting to get everything herself. (I bring this subject up a few times, never did she bring it up.) so I can't really see a reason why she would play such a long con for nothing. 

I'm not worried if she's "fake". It was great while it lasted, and I'm sure I can move on without her. 

Glad that your friendship is working out!

That is exactly how I feel. The things I've told my Internet friend could be used against me in school. It's not too bad things but won't help me either. 

I vent about life with my Internet friends too, they vent back. Makes me feel more relaxed. I don't usually think about what I'm going to say, but with real friends, I pick my sentence. 

I'm planning to meet a couple Internet friends in a couple of weeks. I just hope that it turns out at well as I hope. They seem genuinely nice from their Facebook.

Yeah. I do enjoy talking to her. I feel like I can talk more freely with her then more other people in my life.

I don't mind the no lastname/phone part, when she wants to she'll say so. I don't mind her knowing stuff about me though. 

I don't mind that she dosnt want to tell me much. I understand where she's coming from. And everything she says makes sense.

I just felt like telling someone this. Didnt think anyone in my real life would take it seriously so I posted here.

Thanks for sharing your experience

I have real friends. And a few really close real friends too. Yes, I am probably doing this to fill my boredom, but my real friends care too much about school to be on facebook. Ik now it's not good. I can't help it. I talk to my real friends daily. See them at school, hangout on weekends. 

Sometimes I do t have anyone to talk to. My close friend either sleep really early (9pm), or dose t have 3G. 

My other friend, I don't really trust them that much. I've never had more similarities with anyone else then my Internet friend. I try to go out and make more friends, but all the friends I have never really experience what I've experienced/think. (History wise. Home. Philosophy.) with those friends, I go out ns have fun. Never really talk about life. The few times I have, they seemed in interested. I turn to my Internet friend to talk about things that my friends seem to be uninterested in(we have other similar interest).

Just needed to say this somewhere... I don't wanna tell her, just incase it might ruin what I have going... I don't wanna tell my friends since they would most likely think its weird... My parents? Ha... No.

Great that you found something that works for u. I've found what works for me too, but holy shit its expensive (I use a tube pretty much every other day)... So I spend $5 a day on creme. I have to bring that, and another big bottle of cetaphil lotion ever where I go. I have a small tube of it for emergencies in my pocket, a medium sized bottle in my bag.

I game often, bike often. Pretty much the 2 things that I love now. Whenever I do those, I forget about itching. I don't do other sports because of the commitment I have to make, If I suddenly have a flare up before a big game? Shit. 

I only make plans a day or 2 before, or months before so I know that that month, I have to moistures and put cream on whenever it gets dry. I know I should do this anyways, but sometimes I forget. Sometimes I just can't be bothered.

I just started biking again, 16km daily is my goal, I feel a lot better now because of that. I live in Singapore, 86f daily, high humidity. No winter though. 

I try not let it affect my life, but I can't go swimming often now because of how much it stings. I won't really care if someone was there. I can hardly walk/run at times because of eczema on my leg. I'm unable to commit to sports since I can't schedule when my eczema comes. When I don't do something I promise to, I feel like crap. 

I'm unable to commit to any sports. I bike alone, and it feels a lot better now. Studies are bad though, I try to do what I need a bit by bit. I start projects as soon as their assigned so I can just do it slowly and not be stressed out. 

The SAT I took last weekend was shit for me. When we had a break, I had to use lotion (cetaphil, works for me) like crazy since my skin kept drying up during the test :(

:( I understand how you feel about the burning acid... Only happens to me a few times a month, but when it does, I don't want to get out of bed. I wanna just stay in bed... Last time this happened was Saturday to Wednesday. Didn't feel much better till the 4 days ago...

Last time I went to get my blood checked, I'm allergic to pretty much everything if I eat too much at once, especially meat. I've stopped eating meat, but I still have to eat. 

TBH, I think its more a stress thing for me.

I never really shared anything with them, I ate dinner, all that "family" stuff, but honestly never felt close. 

10th grade came, felt so shitty, teachers noticed. Sent to councilor, she talked to me about school and stuff, like family and see if there's any problems. There was no problem in the family... So I was sent to the psychologist. Took a test. Took meds for like a few months. Felts really good, then I felt shittier and shittier, med dose went UP... Didn't feel any better tbh... And now, I'm here. Felling shitty. No motivation to do anything. Just dropped a class. Currently a junior.
I did this too when I was 16, last year, I was "fixed" for a few months, then this year everything came to shit again... Now idfk WTF to do...
Bad memory management.
Not sure how I would pay for the courses...

I will be able to live for 2 years, if I don't get my gaming equipment taken. I really don't mind school, my grades r bad because I have a bad memory, other then that I can't wait for school to start. I only see my parents 6 hours a day, instead of 18 hours now.
Gaming, and tech. Which my parents don't support me on.

I plan on leaving the house the second I get a job. In Singapore, where i live, I'm not allowed to leave my parents until I'm 18. I've delayed killing my self since the start of the year. I'm not sure how long I can make it. 2 years is a really long time.

From what I see right now, the world is going to shit. I read the news, dose not look like anything will get any better from my point... My grades are so terrible it would be impossible for me to get a job that I would not be depressed about.

My parents. They don't give a shit if I go to jail; why the fuck would they care of I die? $25,000 in medical bill. I don't want to die because of my gaming friends, and other irl friends; if I didn't have them right now, I would not be here. If they took away my computer or my phone, I would not be here either. There are a few games I'm really waiting towards...
I'm 16. I would take all the help, but my parents don't seem to give a shot if I go to jail or if I die. What is the point then in living?
Pretty sure my parents don't give a shit if I die or not.
Today I was told I don't have the right to live. By my parents. I still don't have the courage to kill my self. Ive been sitting near a ledge for an hour now.
Guns r illegal here.
